Manu.name: Vaivasvata Manu
Manu.note: Son of Surya Deva; progenitor of humankind in this age and father of Ikshvaku, first of the solar kings.

people.Ikshvaku: Son of Vaivasvata Manu; founder of the solar dynasty (Suryavamsha) and first king of Kosala at Ayodhya.
people.Mandhata: A world-conquering emperor of the Ikshvaku line, several generations after Ikshvaku.
people.Harishchandra: The king who never told a lie, giving up throne, wife and son rather than break his word; generations after Mandhata.
people.Sagara: Emperor whose sixty thousand sons were burnt to ash for disturbing the sage Kapila; generations after Harishchandra.
people.Asamanja: Wayward son of Sagara, exiled for his cruelty.
people.Amshuman: Grandson of Sagara who recovered the sacrificial horse; father of Bhagiratha.
people.Bhagiratha: Son of Amshuman; by fierce penance he brought the Ganga down from heaven to earth to redeem Sagara's sons, hence the river Bhagirathi.
people.Dilipa: Son of Bhagiratha; the ideal king whose devotion to the divine cow Nandini won him his son Raghu, the hero of Kalidasa's Raghuvamsha.
people.Raghu: Son of Dilipa; so glorious an emperor that the line is called the Raghuvamsha after him.
people.Aja: Son of Raghu; father of Dasharatha.
people.Dasharatha: King of Kosala at Ayodhya; father of Rama by three queens. His promise to Kaikeyi sent Rama into exile and broke his own heart.
people.Rama: Eldest son of Dasharatha, by Kausalya; the seventh avatar of Vishnu, exiled fourteen years, who slew Ravana to win back Sita.
people.Bharata: Son of Dasharatha by Kaikeyi; he refused the throne his mother seized and ruled only as regent for Rama's sandals.
people.Lakshmana: Son of Dasharatha by Sumitra; Rama's devoted brother who followed him into exile and warred at his side.
people.Shatrughna: Youngest son of Dasharatha by Sumitra, twin of Lakshmana; the slayer of the demon Lavana.
people.Lava: Son of Rama and Sita, born in the forest hermitage; twin of Kusha.
people.Kusha: Son of Rama and Sita, born in the forest hermitage; twin of Lava. Kusha and Lava sang the Ramayana before their father, not knowing him.
people.Chandraketu: Son of Lakshmana and Urmila (Lakshmana also had a son Angada, a namesake of the vanara prince).
people.Taksha: Son of Bharata and Mandavi; he gave his name to Takshashila.
people.Subahu: Son of Shatrughna and Shrutakirti; king of Mathura.

Surya.name: Surya Deva
Surya.note: The deva of the sun and fount of the solar dynasty (Suryavamsha): through Vaivasvata Manu he fathers the line of Ikshvaku and Rama, and in this age he is also the divine father of the vanara Sugriva.
